correctness.rationale: Exact characteristic polynomial and Heron factorization divide overdamped and oscillatory cases; strict overdamped derivative rules out any optimum there. Monotone cheapest-rate movement reduces the triangle cone to its boundary; a positive 2x2 matrix generalized Perron eigenproblem yields the sharp formula and uniqueness. Price ties are handled by sharp cost inequalities; all-equal gives continuum. Standalone checker replayed 54,319 assertions; real-parameter proof does not depend on sampling.
